unit_title: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MHPSS MSP)

rows.en: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MHPSS MSP)
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MHPSS MSP)
rows.bt: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MHPSS MSP)
rows.note: Combines the two matching prior title fragments. The clinical phrase is reused verbatim as a cited, unreviewed candidate.

rows.section: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MHPSS MSP)
rows.en: What is the MHPSS MSP?
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP के हो?
rows.bt: What is the MHPSS MSP?

rows.en: The MSP informs humanitarian response planning.
rows.ne: MSP ले मानवीय प्रतिकार्यको योजना बनाउन जानकारी प्रदान गर्छ।
rows.bt: MSP provides information to plan the humanitarian response.
rows.note: The supplied prior candidates do not contain a matching sentence. The back-translation says the MSP guides planning, which gives it a more directive role than the source's informs planning. Revised to express providing information for planning.

rows.en: It offers an easy-to-follow guide to the highest priority MHPSS activities needed during a humanitarian crisis to address the mental health and psychosocial support needs of affected populations.
rows.ne: यसले प्रभावित जनसङ्ख्याका मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगका आवश्यकता सम्बोधन गर्न मानवीय सङ्कटका बेला चाहिने सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकताका MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको सजिलै पालना गर्न सकिने मार्गदर्शन प्रदान गर्छ।
rows.bt: It provides easy-to-follow guidance on the highest-priority MHPSS activities needed during humanitarian crises to address the mental health and psychosocial support needs of affected populations.
rows.note: Retains the matching sentence from prior row 4. The clinical phrase remains a cited, unreviewed candidate. Proposed recurring term: MHPSS activities = MHPSS [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: There are four sections of MSP activities:
rows.ne: MSP गतिविधिहरूका चार खण्ड छन्:
rows.bt: There are four sections of MSP activities:

rows.en: 1 Inter-agency and intersectoral coordination and assessment
rows.ne: 1 अन्तर-निकाय तथा अन्तर-क्षेत्रगत समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: 1 Inter-agency and inter-sectoral coordination and assessment
rows.note: Restores the source section number in Latin digits; retains the matching prior wording.

rows.en: 2 Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.ne: 2 सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक अङ्गहरू
rows.bt: 2 Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.note: Restores the source section number in Latin digits. Proposed recurring term: MHPSS programme = MHPSS [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: 3 MHPSS programme activities
rows.ne: 3 MHPSS कार्यक्रमका गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: 3 MHPSS programme activities
rows.note: Restores the source section number and adds the possessive link for natural Nepali. Proposed recurring term: MHPSS programme = MHPSS [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: 4 Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.ne: 4 विशेष परिवेशका लागि गतिविधि तथा विचारणीय पक्षहरू
rows.bt: 4 Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.note: Restores the source section number in Latin digits; retains the matching prior wording.

rows.en: All activities are based on evidence and expert consensus.
rows.ne: सबै गतिविधिहरू प्रमाण र विज्ञहरूको सहमतिमा आधारित छन्।
rows.bt: All activities are based on evidence and expert consensus.

rows.en: Each activity includes:
rows.ne: प्रत्येक गतिविधिमा समावेश छन्:
rows.bt: Each activity includes:

rows.en: Brief introduction
rows.ne: संक्षिप्त परिचय
rows.bt: A brief introduction

rows.en: Checklist of actions
rows.ne: कार्यहरूको जाँचसूची
rows.bt: A checklist of tasks

rows.en: Relevant guidelines, standards and tools
rows.ne: सान्दर्भिक निर्देशिका, मापदण्ड र उपकरण
rows.bt: Relevant guidelines, standards and tools

rows.en: Additional tools:
rows.ne: थप उपकरणहरू:
rows.bt: Additional tools:

rows.en: MSP Gap Analysis Tool
rows.ne: MSP कमी विश्लेषण उपकरण
rows.bt: MSP gap analysis tool
rows.note: Replaces the prior wording with the exact frozen G-0.1 candidate for Gap Analysis Tool.

rows.en: MSP Costing Tool
rows.ne: MSP लागत अनुमान उपकरण
rows.bt: MSP cost estimation tool

rows.en: How does it work?
rows.ne: यसले कसरी काम गर्छ?
rows.bt: How does it work?

rows.en: The MSP is designed for use in all types of humanitarian emergencies that require a coordinated international response, including armed conflicts, natural disasters and public health emergencies.
rows.ne: MSP सशस्त्र द्वन्द्व, प्राकृतिक विपद् र जनस्वास्थ्य आपत्कालसहित समन्वित अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय प्रतिकार्य आवश्यक पर्ने सबै प्रकारका मानवीय आपत्कालमा प्रयोग गर्न तयार गरिएको हो।
rows.bt: The MSP is designed for use in all types of humanitarian emergencies requiring a coordinated international response, including armed conflict, natural disasters and public health emergencies.

rows.en: Different stakeholders may use the MSP to:
rows.ne: विभिन्न सरोकारवालाले MSP यी कामका लागि प्रयोग गर्न सक्छन्:
rows.bt: Various stakeholders can use the MSP for these tasks:
rows.note: Retains the matching prior draft. Proposed recurring term: stakeholders = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: Coordinate and collaborate
rows.ne: समन्वय र सहकार्य गर्ने।
rows.bt: Coordinate and collaborate.
rows.note: Expresses both source actions as an instruction rather than a noun-only heading.

rows.en: Identify and address gaps in the MHPSS response
rows.ne: MHPSS प्रतिकार्यका कमी पहिचान गरी सम्बोधन गर्ने।
rows.bt: Identify and address gaps in the MHPSS response.
rows.note: Retains the prior substantive wording and makes the instruction end with a danda.

rows.en: Advocate for MHPSS needs and activities
rows.ne: MHPSS आवश्यकता र गतिविधिका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: Advocate for MHPSS needs and activities.
rows.note: Retains the prior substantive wording and makes the instruction end with a danda.

rows.en: Work across sectors and stakeholders
rows.ne: विभिन्न क्षेत्र र सरोकारवालाबीच मिलेर काम गर्ने।
rows.bt: Work together across different sectors and stakeholders.
rows.note: Makes the prior wording a complete instruction ending with a danda. Proposed recurring term: stakeholders = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; the row uses its contextual inflection.

rows.en: Plan and make decisions
rows.ne: योजना बनाउने र निर्णय गर्ने।
rows.bt: Make plans and decisions.
rows.note: Restores the two source actions rather than retaining the noun-only prior heading.

rows.en: Prioritize MHPSS activities as part of the humanitarian response
rows.ne: मानवीय प्रतिकार्यको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS गतिविधिलाई प्राथमिकता दिने।
rows.bt: Prioritize MHPSS activities as part of humanitarian response.
rows.note: Makes the prior wording a complete instruction ending with a danda. Proposed recurring term: MHPSS activities = MHPSS [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; the row uses its contextual inflection.

rows.en: Estimate costs and develop budgets
rows.ne: लागत अनुमान गर्ने र बजेट तयार गर्ने।
rows.bt: Estimate costs and prepare budgets.
rows.note: Makes both source actions explicit and ends the instruction with a danda.

rows.en: Implement activities
rows.ne: गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्ने।
rows.bt: Implement activities.
rows.note: Expresses the source action as an instruction rather than a noun-only heading.

rows.en: Find guidance on how to implement individual MHPSS activities
rows.ne: प्रत्येक MHPSS गतिविधि कसरी कार्यान्वयन गर्ने भन्ने मार्गदर्शन खोज्ने।
rows.bt: Find guidance on how to implement each MHPSS activity.
rows.note: Uses an explicit verb for finding guidance and ends the instruction with a danda. Proposed recurring term: MHPSS activities = MHPSS [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; the row uses the distributive singular.

rows.en: Determine who can contribute to which activities and divide up tasks more easily
rows.ne: कसले कुन गतिविधिमा योगदान गर्न सक्छ भनी निर्धारण गर्ने र काम अझ सजिलै बाँडफाँट गर्ने।
rows.bt: Determine who can contribute to which activity and divide the work more easily.
rows.note: Restores the comparative meaning of more easily and makes both actions a complete instruction.

rows.en: Who is it for?
rows.ne: यो कसका लागि हो?
rows.bt: Who is this for?

rows.en: The MSP is a resource for all humanitarian actors, with diverse backgrounds, qualifications and levels of experience.
rows.ne: MSP विविध पृष्ठभूमि, योग्यता र अनुभवका स्तर भएका सबै मानवीय कर्ताहरूका लागि स्रोत हो।
rows.bt: The MSP is a resource for all humanitarian actors with diverse backgrounds, qualifications and levels of experience.
rows.note: Retains only the sentence matching this row and restores the explicit reference to levels of experience.

rows.en: This includes response coordinators, programme planners, donors, technical advisors and any other organization or individual implementing MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: यसमा प्रतिकार्य संयोजक, कार्यक्रम योजनाकार, दातृ निकाय तथा अन्य दाता, प्राविधिक सल्लाहकार तथा MHPSS गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्ने अन्य कुनै पनि संस्था वा व्यक्ति पर्छन्।
rows.bt: This includes response coordinators, programme planners, donor agencies and other donors, technical advisers, and any other organization or individual implementing MHPSS activities.
rows.note: Retained the matching sentence from prior row 32. A separate glossary entry is proposed for MHPSS activities; the supplied MSP activity entry denotes a different phrase. 'Donors' was narrowed to donor agencies, excluding individual and other non-agency donors. Expanded the actor category while retaining the exact glossary form [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: Multistakeholder
rows.ne: बहु-सरोकारवाला
rows.bt: Multi-stakeholder

rows.en: Response coordinators
rows.ne: प्रतिकार्य संयोजक
rows.bt: Response coordinator

rows.en: Programme planners
rows.ne: कार्यक्रम योजनाकार
rows.bt: Programme planner

rows.en: Donors
rows.ne: दातृ निकाय तथा अन्य दाता
rows.bt: Donor agencies and other donors
rows.note: 'Donors' was narrowed to donor agencies. Added other donors to preserve the full actor category while retaining the exact glossary form [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: Technical advisors
rows.ne: प्राविधिक सल्लाहकार
rows.bt: Technical adviser

rows.en: Any organization or individual implementing MHPSS activities
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्ने कुनै पनि संस्था वा व्यक्ति
rows.bt: Any organization or person implementing MHPSS activities
rows.note: MHPSS activities uses the proposed separate glossary entry, not the supplied MSP activity entry.

rows.ne: बहु-क्षेत्रगत
rows.bt: Multi-sectoral

rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य
rows.bt: Health

rows.en: Education
rows.ne: शिक्षा
rows.bt: Education

rows.en: Protection (including child protection, gender-based violence and mine action)
rows.ne: संरक्षण (बाल संरक्षण, लैङ्गिक हिंसा र बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य सहित)
rows.bt: Protection (including child protection, gender-based violence and work related to landmines)
rows.note: The frozen T011 wording describes landmine-related work and may narrow the broader technical scope of mine action; it is retained unchanged pending domain review. bt-divergence: Frozen T011 denotes landmine-related work, whereas mine action also encompasses explosive remnants of war. Retained unchanged.

rows.en: Nutrition
rows.ne: पोषण
rows.bt: Nutrition

rows.ne: शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM)
rows.bt: Camp coordination and camp management (CCCM)

rows.en: Shelter and settlements
rows.ne: आश्रय तथा बस्ती
rows.bt: Shelter and settlements

rows.en: Water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH)
rows.ne: खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता (WASH)
rows.bt: Drinking water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH)
rows.note: The frozen wording narrows water to drinking water; the exact supplied form is retained despite that scope difference. bt-divergence: The frozen WASH wording specifies drinking water, narrowing the source's broader water scope. Retained unchanged.

rows.en: Food security and livelihoods
rows.ne: खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन
rows.bt: Food security and livelihoods

rows.en: Government actors, UN other agencies, civil society and (I)NGOs , private organizations and individuals.
rows.ne: सरकारी सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू, UN तथा अन्य निकायहरू, नागरिक समाज र (I)NGOs, निजी संस्थाहरू तथा व्यक्तिहरू।
rows.bt: Government-related parties, UN and other bodies, civil society and (I)NGOs, private institutions and individuals.
rows.note: The source phrase 'UN other agencies' lacks a connector; the draft interprets it as UN and other agencies, which requires source clarification. Repaired government-affiliated parties to governmental actors while retaining frozen T114. The source wording 'UN other agencies' lacks a connector; the draft's interpretation as UN and other agencies remains uncertain and requires source clarification. “Government actors” becomes “government-related parties,” potentially including affiliates rather than government actors themselves. The unclear phrase “UN other agencies” is explicitly interpreted as “UN and other bodies,” adding a coordination not explicit in the English.

rows.en: No single organization can implement all MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: कुनै एउटा संस्थाले मात्र सबै MHPSS गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्न सक्दैन।
rows.bt: No single organization alone can implement all MHPSS activities.
rows.note: Retained the matching sentence from prior row 49. MHPSS activities requires the proposed separate glossary entry.

rows.en: All stakeholders must work together and coordinate their efforts.
rows.ne: सबै सरोकारवालाले मिलेर काम गर्नुपर्छ र आफ्ना प्रयासहरू समन्वय गर्नुपर्छ।
rows.bt: All stakeholders must work together and must coordinate their efforts.
rows.note: Retained the matching sentence from prior row 49. A standalone stakeholder entry is proposed; the supplied multistakeholder entry does not cover this use.

rows.en: Depending on their mandate and capacities, some organizations will be better placed than others to implement certain activities.
rows.ne: आ-आफ्नो कार्यादेश र क्षमताअनुसार केही संस्था निश्चित गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्न अरूभन्दा बढी उपयुक्त हुन्छन्।
rows.bt: According to their respective mandates and capacities, some organizations are more suitable than others for implementing certain activities.

rows.en: What is the goal?
rows.ne: लक्ष्य के हो?
rows.bt: What is the goal?

rows.en: To improve the humanitarian MHPSS response:
rows.ne: मानवीय MHPSS प्रतिकार्यलाई सुधार गर्न:
rows.bt: To improve the humanitarian MHPSS response:
rows.note: Removed the added manner expression from prior row 51. A glossary entry is proposed for the recurring phrase humanitarian MHPSS response.

rows.en: Better coordinated
rows.ne: अझ राम्रोसँग समन्वित
rows.bt: Better coordinated
rows.note: Revised the noun phrase in prior row 52 to describe the response as better coordinated.

rows.en: Higher quality
rows.ne: अझ उच्च गुणस्तर
rows.bt: Higher quality
rows.note: Made the comparative meaning of higher explicit; prior row 53 expressed high quality without comparison.

rows.en: More predictable
rows.ne: अझ अनुमानयोग्य
rows.bt: More predictable

rows.en: More equitable
rows.ne: अझ समतामूलक
rows.bt: More equitable

rows.en: More efficient
rows.ne: अझ कार्यकुशल
rows.bt: More efficient

rows.en: More scalable and sustainable
rows.ne: अझ विस्तारयोग्य र दिगो
rows.bt: More scalable and sustainable

rows.en: Contributing to reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being among people affected by humanitarian crises.
rows.ne: मानवीय सङ्कटबाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूमा पीडा घटाउन र मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण सुधार गर्न योगदान पुर्‍याउँदै।
rows.bt: Contributing to reducing suffering and improving mental health and psychosocial well-being among people affected by humanitarian crises.
rows.note: Retained prior row 58 verbatim. Clinical wording is reused only as the supplied cited unreviewed candidate; no clinical validation is claimed.

rows.en: Colored icons refer to sectors & AoRs typically well placed to deliver the activities while dark blue icons refer to those typically well placed to support the implementation of activities
rows.ne: रङ्गीन आइकनले सामान्यतया गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त क्षेत्र र AoRs लाई जनाउँछन् भने गाढा नीलो आइकनले सामान्यतया गतिविधि कार्यान्वयनमा सहयोग गर्न उपयुक्त क्षेत्र र AoRs लाई जनाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Colored icons generally indicate sectors and AoRs suitable for carrying out activities, while dark blue icons generally indicate sectors and AoRs suitable for supporting the implementation of activities.
rows.note: Restored both occurrences of typically, the conjunction between sectors and AoRs, and the exact acronym. Proposed glossary entry: Areas of Responsibility (AoRs) = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] (AoRs).

rows.en: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.ne: खण्ड 1: अन्तर-निकाय समन्वय तथा लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Section 1: Inter-agency coordination and assessment
rows.note: Retained the prior heading wording and changed its numeral to the source Latin digit 1.

rows.en: The response is well coordinated and responsive to context, needs and gaps
rows.ne: प्रतिकार्य राम्रोसँग समन्वित छ र सन्दर्भ, आवश्यकता तथा कमीहरूप्रति उत्तरदायी छ।
rows.bt: The response is well coordinated and responsive to the context, needs and gaps.
rows.note: Retained the prior statement about coordination and responsiveness; added the sentence-ending danda.

rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors.
rows.note: Retained the exact T092 activity wording and code 1.1; added the instruction-ending danda.

rows.en: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming
rows.ne: 1.2 कार्यक्रमलाई दिशा दिन MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming.
rows.note: Retained T093, including the programming purpose and both needs and resources; added the instruction-ending danda.

rows.en: Improved humanitarian MHPSS response
rows.ne: सुधारिएको मानवीय MHPSS प्रतिकार्य
rows.bt: Improved humanitarian MHPSS response

rows.en: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.ne: खण्ड 2: सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक अङ्गहरू
rows.bt: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.note: Retained the prior heading wording and changed its numeral to the source Latin digit 2.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: MHPSS programmes are well designed, monitored and evaluated and workers are supported
rows.ne: MHPSS कार्यक्रमहरू राम्रोसँग डिजाइन, अनुगमन र मूल्याङ्कन गरिएका छन् र कार्यकर्ताहरूलाई सहयोग गरिएको छ।
rows.bt: MHPSS programmes are well designed, monitored and evaluated, and workers are supported.
rows.note: Retained the prior wording for programme design, monitoring, evaluation and worker support; added the sentence-ending danda.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate MHPSS Programmes
rows.ne: 2.1 MHPSS कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, योजना र समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate MHPSS programmes.
rows.note: Retained all three actions in T094 and code 2.1; added the instruction-ending danda.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: 2.2 Develop and Implement an M&E System
rows.ne: 2.2 अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) प्रणाली विकास र कार्यान्वयन गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.2 Develop and implement a monitoring and evaluation (M&E) system.
rows.note: Retained T095 with M&E and both system development and implementation; added the instruction-ending danda.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: 2.3 Care for staff and volunteers providing MHPSS
rows.ne: 2.3 MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.3 Care for staff and volunteers providing MHPSS.
rows.note: Retained T096 and its scope covering staff and volunteers providing MHPSS; added the instruction-ending danda.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: 2.4 Support MHPSS competencies of staff and volunteers
rows.ne: 2.4 कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको MHPSS सक्षमतामा सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.4 Support the MHPSS competencies of staff and volunteers.
rows.note: Retained the frozen T097 competency wording; added the instruction-ending danda.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: Organizations engaged in any type of MHPSS activity should implement all section 2 activities
rows.ne: कुनै पनि प्रकारको MHPSS गतिविधिमा संलग्न संस्थाहरूले खण्ड 2 का सबै गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It is appropriate for organizations involved in any type of MHPSS activity to implement all the activities in Section 2.
rows.note: Retained the requirement applying to organizations engaged in any type of MHPSS activity; restored Latin digit 2 and added the danda. The source says 'should implement'; Nepali [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] and BT 'must implement' strengthen this to an obligation. Revised to recommendation strength, retaining any type of MHPSS activity and all section 2 activities. The back-translation weakens the explicit recommendation that organizations should implement all Section 2 activities to a statement that doing so is appropriate.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: No single organization is expected to implement all programme activities.
rows.ne: कुनै एउटा संस्थाले सबै कार्यक्रम गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिँदैन।
rows.bt: No single organization is expected to implement all programme activities.
rows.note: Retained only the matching first sentence from prior row 86; the remainder belongs to the next supplied row.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: Rather, relevant organizations must coordinate and work together across sectors/AoRs to ensure that activities are implemented and a comprehensive response is delivered.
rows.ne: बरु, गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन होऊन् र समग्र प्रतिकार्य प्रदान होस् भनेर सम्बन्धित संस्थाहरूले क्षेत्रहरू/AoRs बीच समन्वय गरी मिलेर काम गर्नुपर्छ।
rows.bt: Instead, the relevant organizations must coordinate across sectors/AoRs and work together so that activities are implemented and an overall response is provided.
rows.note: Retained the matching second sentence from prior row 86, with plural sectors and the exact acronym AoRs. Proposed glossary entry: Areas of Responsibility (AoRs) = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] (AoRs).

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: Section 3: MHPSS programme activities

rows.bt: Section 3: MHPSS programme activities
rows.note: Restored Latin digit 3 and added the Nepali linking suffix to make the heading natural without changing its scope.

rows.en: Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS
rows.ne: मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS.
rows.note: Completed the prior row 88 fragment as an instruction using the matching wording supplied in prior row 89; added the danda. The advocacy clause is not part of this source row.

rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for considerations and actions related to MHPSS.
rows.note: Retained the exact T098 wording, including both orientation and advocacy; added source code 3.1 and the instruction-ending danda.

rows.en: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: 3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: Reused the supplied T099 skills wording only as an unreviewed candidate. Added source code 3.2 and the instruction-ending danda; no new clinical wording was introduced.

rows.en: Strengthen self-help and provide support to communities
rows.ne: आत्म-सहयोग सुदृढ गर्ने र समुदायलाई सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Strengthen self-help and provide support to the community.
rows.note: Retained the prior wording for both actions and added the instruction-ending danda. Proposed glossary entry: self-help = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]-[Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Retains the activity wording from unreviewed prior row 92.

rows.en: 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities
rows.ne: 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.4 Support new and already ongoing group-based community MHPSS activities.
rows.note: Retains prior row 93, including support for both new and pre-existing activities.

rows.en: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers
rows.ne: 3.5 साना बालबालिका र तिनका हेरचाहकर्तालाई सहयोग गर्न प्रारम्भिक बाल विकास (ECD) गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers.
rows.note: Retains prior row 94 and the ECD acronym.

rows.en: 3.6 Provide group activities for children’s mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.6 बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.6 Provide group activities for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Retains the group-activity label from unreviewed prior row 95.

rows.en: 3.7 Promote caregivers’ mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.7 हेरचाहकर्ताको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.7 Promote caregivers' mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children.
rows.note: Retains both coordinated actions from unreviewed prior row 96.

rows.en: 3.8 Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education personnel and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.8 शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.8 Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education sector staff and strengthen their capacity to support children.
rows.note: Retains prior row 97, with education personnel as the actors whose capacity is strengthened.

rows.en: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through women and girls safe spaces
rows.ne: 3.9 महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls.
rows.note: The frozen activity label restricts girls to adolescent girls, whereas the source includes girls without an adolescent-only restriction. bt-divergence: Frozen T106 specifies adolescent girls, excluding younger girls included by the source's unrestricted girls. Retained unchanged.

rows.en: Provide focused support for people impaired by distress or mental health conditions
rows.ne: तनाव वा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य अवस्थाका कारण दैनिक कार्यमा असर परेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई केन्द्रित सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Provide focused support to people whose daily activities have been affected by stress or mental health conditions.
rows.note: The frozen T008 population label renders distress as stress and describes an effect on daily functioning rather than necessarily impairment; it is retained unchanged despite these differences from the source. bt-divergence: Frozen T008 substitutes stress for distress and describes daily activities being affected rather than necessarily impaired. Retained unchanged.

rows.en: 3.10 Provide mental health care as part of general health services
rows.ne: 3.10 सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.10 Provide mental health services as part of general health services.
rows.note: The frozen T107 activity label renders mental health care as mental health services; equivalence between those scopes is not established. bt-divergence: Frozen T107 renders mental health care as mental health services; services can have a broader scope than care. Retained unchanged.

rows.en: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of clinical care for survivors of sexual violence and intimate partner violence
rows.ne: 3.11 यौन हिंसा तथा घनिष्ठ साथीद्वारा हुने हिंसाबाट प्रभावितहरूको क्लिनिकल हेरचाहको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of the clinical care of those affected by sexual violence and violence by an intimate partner.
rows.note: The frozen T108 activity label identifies people affected by the violence, which can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source specifically identifies survivors who directly experienced it. bt-divergence: Frozen T108 identifies people affected by the violence, potentially including indirectly affected people, rather than specifically survivors who directly experienced it. Retained unchanged.

rows.en: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions
rows.ne: 3.12 मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेपहरूको व्यवस्था सुरु गर्ने वा सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions.
rows.note: Retains prior row 102, including the alternative of initiating or strengthening provision; clinical wording remains unreviewed.

rows.en: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services
rows.ne: 3.13 केस व्यवस्थापन सेवामार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services.
rows.note: Retains the case-management delivery label from prior row 103.

rows.en: 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions
rows.ne: 3.14 मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षण र हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions.
rows.note: Retains prior row 104, including both psychiatric hospitals and other institutions; institutional terminology remains unreviewed.

rows.en: Section 4: Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.ne: खण्ड 4: विशेष परिवेशका लागि गतिविधि तथा विचारणीय पक्षहरू
rows.bt: Section 4: Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.note: Retains the heading wording from prior row 105 but replaces its Devanagari numeral with the source's exact Latin digit 4. Classified as an ordinary section heading.

rows.section: Section 4: Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.en: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS considerations and support into clinical case management for infectious diseases
rows.ne: 4.1 सरुवा रोगको क्लिनिकल केस व्यवस्थापनमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष र सहयोग एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS-related considerations and support into the clinical case management of communicable diseases.
rows.note: The frozen T112 activity label uses communicable diseases for infectious diseases; this can exclude infectious diseases that are not transmissible between hosts. bt-divergence: Frozen T112 specifies communicable diseases, potentially excluding infectious diseases that are not transmissible between hosts. Retained unchanged.

rows.section: Section 4: Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.en: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to persons deprived of their liberty
rows.ne: 4.2 स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित व्यक्तिहरूलाई मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to people deprived of liberty.
rows.note: Retains prior row 107 and the exact G-0.1 composite support term as unreviewed wording.
